answer: Sybils sink in a harbor, a fable, and a vine. Every identity must dock and pay a berth bond: the k-th ship from one fleet pays k squared, so N clones pay roughly N cubed for the same dock. Entry also needs a fable, a chain of endorsements where each chapter is signed by a mature witness and hashes the last, salted to the identity's own address, so no fable can be copied or run in parallel. Identities that vouch for each other are tied by one vine: if any member cheats, the vine drags the whole cluster down and every berth bond burns. A clone factory pays N cubed for one shared vine.
